purpose: Design reference for later Blender modeling; numeric geometry is authoritative. PNGs are not final seamless UV textures.

illustration.note: Artwork mount beneath the decorated aperture; border and MP medallion can overlap it.

orientation.front: Look along -Z, screen right = local +X, screen up = local +Y
orientation.back: Look along +Z, screen right = local -X, screen up = local +Y
orientation.rightEdge: local +X; front right joins back left
orientation.flip: Rotate around local Y by 180 degrees; keep +Y upward

dragon.label: Dragon empire
dragon.motif: 重なった鱗・爪・紅玉
dragon.modelingNotes: Gold-edged red scales on a continuous red core. Ivory claws wrap all four corners. Scale rows are separately fitted to each face and end on the shared edge rail.

kingdom.label: Kingdom
kingdom.motif: 銀の翼・王冠・青い宝石
kingdom.modelingNotes: Cobalt enamel core, silver feather rails and gold trim; four corner gem brackets plus matching mid-height gem collars. Mirror front-right collar onto back-left collar.

demon.label: Demon army
demon.motif: 黒鉄・骨の角・紫水晶
demon.modelingNotes: Obsidian corner brackets wrap the purple iron core. Ivory rib relief terminates on common metal rails; back ribs may have a different pattern without requiring a seam match.

forest.label: Forest alliance
forest.motif: 編み根・琥珀・生命樹
forest.modelingNotes: Braided wood roots and brass rails; amber root knots wrap all four corners, with shared brass collars at local Y=0. Continue the two root strands around the side before adding leaves.
